data.title: 神罚 · 纯白绒羽里的依恋啼鸣
data.action: 跪坐在床中央，双手把指挥官的大衣紧紧抱在怀里，红瞳忽闪忽闪，纯真无邪地歪着头甜笑，发丝凌乱散落。
data.location: 前哨基地指挥官卧室，床头摆放着柔软的泰迪熊与机械积木
data.lighting: 透过白纱帘的柔白晨光，将整个被褥烘托得如梦似幻般纯净明朗
data.mood: 犹如初生幼鸟般的极致依恋与纯洁无垢的爱意
data.description: 前哨基地指挥官卧室，床头摆放着柔软的泰迪熊与机械积木。跪坐在床中央，双手把指挥官的大衣紧紧抱在怀里，红瞳忽闪忽闪，纯真无邪地歪着头甜笑，发丝凌乱散落。 她微微抬眸轻语——“指挥官的大衣，有指挥官的味道……只要在指挥官身边，玛丽安哪里也不去！”
data.promptProse: Kneeling on the commander's bed at dawn beside a plush teddy bear, Modernia wears a pure white sheer chiffon slip dress laced with soft white satin ribbons. Hugging a dark trenchcoat tightly against her chest with tousled silver hair and a warm, innocent smile, she glows in soft morning curtain light.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling in the center of the bed in a sheer white ribbon-wrapped slip dress, she hugs the commander's oversized black coat tightly to her chest and tilts her head with a bright, innocent smile. Soft morning sunlight filters through white curtains beside her teddy bear.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure white sheer chiffon slip dress wrapped with criss-crossing white satin ribbons and a light layered ruffled hem.
